Subject: Request: alternate billing cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the smooth onboarding call yesterday. Finance ran the numbers against our Q1 budget and asked whether we can shift the billing cadence for our Redwood contract so invoices align with our internal fiscal quarters. Specifically they're requesting either: (A) split invoices monthly (three invoices per quarter) with standard Net-30 payment on each invoice, or (B) keep one quarterly invoice but push to Net-90 to match our vendor payment cycle.

Attached is our PO (Praxis_PO_1009.pdf) which references the SOW. We realize these are non-standard terms — happy to accept a short administration fee if needed. Can you advise what is possible and what approvals are required?

Hi team — reviewed Praxis' PO and the SOW. Summary and recommended paths:

Context: Signed SOW in Drive; total first-year ARR $480k (paid quarterly by default). Praxis requests either monthly split invoices or a quarterly invoice on Net-90.

Operational impact: Monthly split requires additional invoice operations and increases AR days; Net-90 increases credit exposure and impacts cash flow and metrics. Finance asked for an executive approval for Net terms > Net-60 or any quarterly Net-90.

Options (tradeoffs):
1) Approve monthly invoices with Net-60 across each invoice. Pros: reduces single large AR hit; cons: more invoicing overhead.
2) Approve quarterly invoice with Net-90. Pros: aligns with Praxis process; cons: higher credit risk and delayed cash.
3) Approve Net-90 but require a purchase-order-backed guarantee and a small administration fee (recommended 0.25% of invoice).

Recommendation: Approve option (1) with Net-60, or option (3) if business insists on Net-90. Both require executive signoff (VP Sales / Finance). Please advise.

Attachments: pricing-summary.xlsx, Signed_SOW_Praxis_Redwood.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@praxisanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Praxis billing cadence approval (DL-2026-0783)

Marissa / Markus — looping you both in for a quick decision. Praxis is asking for a non-standard billing cadence; Ben's summary below outlines the options.

Why this matters: Praxis is a mid-market analytics customer with a clear onboarding timeline; approving smoother terms materially increases the likelihood of upsell in H2. However, Net-90 would have a meaningful short-term cash impact (~$360k receivable delay).

Ask: Can we approve one of the following so I can get Praxis the final amendment and close:
- Approve monthly split invoices with Net-60 (recommended by Deal Desk), OR
- Approve quarterly invoice Net-90 with a 0.25% admin fee and PO guarantee.

If approved, legal will issue an amendment and I'll confirm the invoicing schedule with Praxis. Olivia — I didn't include finance in this thread to keep the thread tight; if approved I'll loop them for billing instructions.

Thanks,
Sofia

- Praxis must re-submit the signed PO with explicit billing contacts and reference to the amendment.
- Legal should prepare a short amendment referencing DL-2026-0783; Accounting to prepare the monthly invoice schedule.
